The '''King''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gascon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Marilla]]. He was courted by both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; his wife supported the Republic, but his [[Holy Advisor]] favored the Empire.
